name: CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS
description: CE_STATEMENT_HEADERS contains the statement header information.

columns.name: STATEMENT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the bank statement header.

columns.name: BALANCE_CHECK
columns.description: Amount difference between the opening balance plus all activities compared to the closing balance reported on the bank statement. If the amount does not equal zero there is an issue with the bank statement and needs to be investigated.

columns.name: STATEMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Statement number. Should be unique within a bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Bank account on which the statement is reported.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the bank statement.

columns.name: ELECTRONIC_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Sequential number of the report, assigned by the account servicer. It is increased incrementally for each report sent electronically.

columns.name: LEGAL_SEQ_NUM
columns.description: Legal sequential number of the report, assigned by the account servicer. It is increased incrementally for each report sent.

columns.name: STATEMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the bank statement was created. It appears on the bank statement.

columns.name: STMT_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Start date or time for which the account statement is issued.

columns.name: STMT_TO_DATE
columns.description: End date or time for which the account statement is issued.

columns.name: RECON_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of Bank Statement Reconciliation.  Valid states are: New: New Statement, never reconciled. Ready: Statement ready for reconciliation. In Process: Reconciliation is in process Complete: Reconciliation is Complete. Reviewed: Statement has been reviewed and approved.

columns.name: AUTOREC_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the automatic reconciliation program completion. Valid values are UNPROCESSED, INPROCESS, WARNING, ERROR, PROCESSED.

columns.name: AUTOREC_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Program identifier of the automatic reconciliation program.

columns.name: STATEMENT_ENTRY_TYPE
columns.description:
Manual: Entered Manually
Electronic: Imported

columns.name: STATEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the statement type. Interim Notification: memo information provided for daily cash flow projections, balances, and entries not booked by bank yet. Booking Notification: final statement data, information booked by bank, and balances reported.

columns.name: INBOUND_FILE_ID
columns.description: Indentifies the file from where the statement is imported. Foreign key to iby_inbound_file table.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
